# Build progress

Checkpoint file for the end-to-end build. Read this first when resuming; update it at the end of every iteration.

**Goal:** build and verify the complete Symplist free closed-beta application from its product notes, screen briefs, and supplied UI sample, with real backend integrations, documented self-hosting, and evidence for the acceptance criteria.

- Branch: `feat/symplist-build` (no upstream; never push to `main`)
- Scope sources: [notes](../notes/files/00_index.md), [screen briefs](../../design/mockups/overall.md), [UI sample](<../../design/UI sample/README.md>), [decisions](decisions.md), [coverage ledger](coverage.md)
- Local runtime: Homebrew Node 24 (`export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@24/bin:$PATH"`), pnpm 12.4.2
- Secrets: the owner supplied live credentials in ignored `.env.local`; distribute and verify them in Phase E using the placement matrix. Never print values.

- 2026-09-16: The collision also produced a real design ruling. The second documents writer had replaced the page view with a textarea per section. The original writer was right to object: §9.3 and the Phase A research decision make the page view Milkdown, and R7's "formatting normalized" commit only makes sense because the remark serializer is a fixed point of the canonical server serializer. The Milkdown design stands and the contradicting files were discarded.
- 2026-09-16: Rule for the rest of the build, learned three times over: never start a workflow over a worktree without positive proof the previous one released it, and check the workflow transcript directories rather than `ListAgents`, which cannot see workflow agents. When an agent asks who owns a worktree, answer it — an unanswered agent stalls forever, and telling agents to yield when they suspect a duplicate makes both yield.
